name: estimate-assignment
description: Estimate feasible current and predecessor-target route legs from local state.

request_format.encoding: JSON object passed as the --request argument
request_format.fields: actions: received action list with id, role, target, duration_s and after. Full search routes and service power are included; preserve the received action geometry so centre can use the bid. Resources come from this UAV telemetry/configured energy model, never request values.

completion.poll: status_flag with the returned request ID
